svg.title: Role and permission matrix · Clinic Front-Desk Operations Platform — Master PRD
svg.desc: Grid of 7 application surfaces against 7 roles, listing the actions each role may take on each surface and the requirements behind them.
svg.text: Roles are quoted from the specification as written; a combined role is one role.
